content: Do not go to the garden of flowers! O friend! go not there; in your body is the garden of flowers.
author: Kabir
explanation: Kabir urges seekers to redirect their external quest for sacred beauty inward. The living essence of creation and divine grace does not reside in distant temples or manicured gardens, but in the center of one's own conscious heart.
practicalInsight: Take ten quiet minutes today without reaching for external stimuli, books, or screens. Rest attention completely within your chest and observe the stillness waiting there.
reflectionPrompt: Where am I still searching outward for an ecstasy or peace that only exists within my own quiet presence?
